common.description: Rent aircraft from verified owners across Europe. Pilots, owners, technicians and airports in one place.

footer.tagline: Made for general aviation in Europe.

home.title: Rent a plane. Fly more.
home.subtitle: Find verified aircraft to rent near you and book with owners who can see your ratings. Hiring technicians and requesting airport services will follow, all in one place.

pilots.title: Pilots
pilots.text: Search aircraft near you by dates, see specs, price per hour and availability, and send a booking request.

owners.title: Owners
owners.text: List your aircraft, manage its calendar and decide who flies it with a minimum pilot rating and experience rules.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.text: Offer 50 h and 100 h checks and other maintenance to owners nearby.

airports.title: Airports
airports.text: Take PPR, apron parking, hangar, fuel and customs requests online.

confirm.suspend: They are logged out and can't log in, book, message or review. Their listed aircraft are unlisted.
confirm.unsuspend: They can log in again. Their aircraft can be listed again by them.
confirm.unlist: The aircraft disappears from search and can't be listed again by the owner until you allow it. Existing bookings stay.
confirm.allow_listing: The owner can list the aircraft again (it stays unlisted until they do).
confirm.hide_review: Only hide reviews that break the rules (abuse, personal data, spam). The rating averages are updated.
confirm.show_review: The review becomes public again and counts in the averages.
confirm.resolve_report: Close the report: action was taken.
confirm.dismiss_report: Close the report: nothing breaks the rules.

done.allow_listing: The owner can list it again.

list.title: Bookings
list.emptyPilot: No bookings yet. Find an aircraft and send a request.
list.exportLegsHint: Your legs from sent and confirmed flight logs, in logbook order, times in UTC. A help for filling in your logbook, not a replacement for it.

detail.answerBy: Please answer by {date}; after that the request expires and the time is freed.
detail.waiting: Waiting for the owner, who has until {date} to answer.
detail.meets: The pilot meets your requirements for this flight.
detail.doesNotMeet: The pilot doesn't meet your requirements for this flight any more.
detail.checkout: The owner asks for a checkout flight with an instructor before the first solo rental.
detail.proposed: The owner can't do this time but suggests {when}.
detail.grounded: The owner has grounded this aircraft. It can't be flown until the owner lists it again.

respond.title: Your answer
respond.notePlaceholder: e.g. The keys are in the club house.
respond.proposeText: Suggest a time that works for you (UTC). The request is declined and the pilot can request your time with one tap.

done.accept: Accepted. The time is booked for the pilot.
done.decline: Declined. The time is free again.
done.propose: Declined with your suggestion. The time is free again.

errors.not_open: This request has already been answered or has expired.
errors.pilot_not_eligible: The pilot no longer meets your requirements for this flight (for example, a credential expired), so it can't be accepted.
errors.bad_proposal: Suggest a time in the future.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.aircraft_grounded: The aircraft is grounded. List it again before accepting.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.lateWarning: The free-cancellation deadline has passed: this will be shown as a late cancellation on your profile.
cancel.done: Cancelled. The time is free again.
cancel.doneLate: Cancelled (late). The time is free again.

errors.not_cancellable: This booking can't be cancelled any more.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

contact.note: Shared because the booking is accepted. Use it only for this booking.
contact.afterAccept: Email and phone are shown here once the owner accepts. Until then, use messages.

usage.none: No confirmed flight logs yet. Usage appears here once you confirm a pilot's log.
usage.note: Fuel and oil used are worked out from the levels before and after each leg, only where both were entered. A rising oil use per engine hour can be an early sign of engine trouble. Not an official technical log.

flightLog.title: Flight log
flightLog.checkoutHint: Checking out starts the rental and opens the flight log. Record the meters, fuel and oil before the first flight.
flightLog.disclaimer: This log is a record between you and the other party. It does not replace the aircraft's official journey log or technical log, or your pilot logbook.
flightLog.correctionNote: The owner asked for a correction: {note}
flightLog.checkoutPhotoHint: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 4 MB. The owner can open it too.
flightLog.noLegs: No legs yet. Add one after each flight.
flightLog.missingMeters: Add the {basis} start and end readings to every leg to work out the amount.
flightLog.payDirectly: Pay the owner directly. No money goes through ownAplane.
flightLog.submit: Check in and send to the owner
flightLog.submitHint: When you're back, check in: the owner checks the log and confirms the amount. You can't change it after that unless the owner asks for a correction.
flightLog.waitingForOwner: Sent. Waiting for the owner to confirm.
flightLog.waitingForPilot: The pilot is still filling in the log.
flightLog.confirmHint: Confirming completes the booking with the time and amount above.

errors.not_found: We couldn't find this flight log.
errors.not_accepted: Only an accepted booking can be checked out.
errors.too_early: Check-out opens 2 hours before the booked time.
errors.not_editable: The log can't be changed now.
errors.no_legs: Add at least one leg first.
errors.not_submitted: The log hasn't been sent yet, or it was already handled.
errors.leg_checks: Check the leg: times must be in order (block off, engine start, take-off, landing, engine stop, block on), within 24 hours, and meters can't go backwards.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.aircraft_grounded: The aircraft is grounded by the owner, so it can't be checked out.

flightLog.noUplifts: Nothing added yet. Record each refuelling or oil top-up with its receipt.
flightLog.upliftHint: Enter what was added and what it cost. Who paid decides how it counts in the amount due.
flightLog.priceHint: Total on the receipt, in the booking's currency.

fuelRule.wet: Wet rate: fuel the pilot paid for, and oil, are taken off.
fuelRule.dry: Dry rate: fuel from the owner's account is added; oil the pilot paid for is taken off.

flightLog.unpriced: {count, plural, one {One fuel or oil entry has} other {# fuel or oil entries have}} no price, so {count, plural, one {it isn't} other {they aren't}} counted in the amount.

remarks.title: Remarks and PIREPs
remarks.pilotHint: Anything the owner or the next pilot should know: things about the aircraft that aren't defects (e.g. "left mag drop 150 rpm", "COM2 scratchy"), and notes on the weather or an airfield.
remarks.ownerHint: What the pilot noted. Mark an aircraft remark as a known item so later renters see it before they fly.
remarks.noneYet: No remarks yet. They appear here when pilots add them to their flight logs.
remarks.bodyHint: Defects that affect airworthiness are reported separately.

knownItems.title: Known items on this aircraft
knownItems.text: The owner knows about these. Check them before you fly.

defects.reportHint: Something wrong with the aircraft that may affect its airworthiness. The owner is told straight away. Remarks that aren't defects go in the flight log.

severities.minor: Minor: can wait for the next maintenance
severities.major: Major: should be fixed before long

defects.descriptionHint: Where, what you noticed and when (e.g. "oil on the left cowl after landing at LBPD").
defects.reported: Defect reported. The owner has been told.

errors.not_found: You can't report a defect on this aircraft.
errors.bad_photo: That photo can't be used. Please upload it again.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

defects.groundedText: Pilots can't book it, and bookings can't be accepted or checked out until you list it again.
defects.groundHint: Ground the aircraft if it shouldn't fly: pilots can't book it and accepted bookings can't be checked out until you list it again.
defects.disclaimer: A record between you and your renters, not the aircraft's technical log. Airworthiness and certificates of release to service stay with you and your maintenance organisation.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Booking requests, answers, flight logs and reminders. You also get them by email.

types.proposed: {other} declined your booking of {registration} and suggested another time.
types.expired: The request for {registration} from {when} expired without an answer.
types.log_submitted: {other} sent the flight log of {registration} for you to confirm.
types.log_correction: {other} asked for a correction to the flight log of {registration}.
types.log_confirmed: {other} confirmed the flight log of {registration}. The booking is complete: review each other within 14 days.
types.review_submitted: {other} reviewed the booking of {registration}. Write yours to see it.
types.reviews_published: The reviews for {registration} are now published.

checkoutFlight.neededPilot: The owner asks for a checkout flight with an instructor before your first solo rental of this aircraft. Arrange it with the owner.
checkoutFlight.neededOwner: You asked for a checkout flight with an instructor before this pilot's first solo rental. Record it here once it's done.
checkoutFlight.done: Checkout flight on this aircraft recorded on {date}
checkoutFlight.recordHint: Record it and the pilot won't need another checkout on this aircraft.
checkoutFlight.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

help.title: Help
help.description: How ownAplane works for pilots, aircraft owners and admins.
help.searchPlaceholder: Search the help, e.g. cancellation or flight log
help.results: {count, plural, =0 {No articles} one {# article} other {# articles}} for “{query}”
help.noResults: Nothing found. Try other words, or clear the search to see all articles.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.writeTextPilot: How was {name}? Your review is hidden until the owner has reviewed you too, or until {date}. You can't change it afterwards.
reviews.writeTextOwner: How was {name} as a pilot? Your review is hidden until the pilot has reviewed you too, or until {date}. You can't change it afterwards.
reviews.windowClosed: The 14 days for reviews have passed.
reviews.hiddenUntil: Only you can see this until the other side has reviewed too, or until {date}.
reviews.commentHintPilot: What should other pilots know? Be fair and factual; no personal data.
reviews.commentHintOwner: What should other owners know? Be fair and factual; no personal data.

aircraft_condition.label: Aircraft condition
aircraft_condition.hint: Clean, working and as described in the listing?

communication.label: Communication
communication.hint: Clear, friendly and quick to answer?

airmanship.label: Airmanship
airmanship.hint: Careful and professional handling of the aircraft?

punctuality.label: Punctuality
punctuality.hint: On time for check-out and return?

condition_returned.label: Condition returned
condition_returned.hint: Clean, fuelled as agreed, no surprises?

errors.window_closed: The 14 days for reviews have passed.
errors.bad_scores: Please give every category 1 to 5 stars.
errors.failed: Couldn't save your review. Please try again.

reviews.replyHint: Everyone who reads the review sees your reply. You can reply once and can't change it later. Stay polite and factual.

replyErrors.not_found: You can't reply to this review.
replyErrors.already_replied: You've already replied to this review.
replyErrors.failed: Couldn't save your reply. Please try again.

reports.hint: Our team checks every report. Reviews are only removed when they break the rules (abuse, personal data, spam), never just for being negative.
reports.alreadyReported: You've already reported this. We'll take a look.
reports.notFound: This can't be reported any more.
reports.tooMany: You have sent many reports today. Please try again tomorrow or contact us.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Your conversations with pilots and owners, about bookings and listings.
messages.none: No messages yet. You can message an owner from an aircraft page, or the other side from a booking.
messages.closed: The other member has left ownAplane, so you can't reply.
messages.label: Your message
messages.hint: Share phone numbers and emails only after the booking is accepted; they're shown on the booking then.
messages.askText: Questions about the aircraft, availability or requirements? The owner gets an email.

errors.not_found: You can't send messages in this conversation.
errors.failed: Couldn't send your message. Please try again.
errors.too_many_messages: You have sent a lot of messages in a short time. Please wait a few minutes.

legal.draft: Draft: this text is still being reviewed by our lawyer and may change before launch.
